products.title: Mitcham charcoal suit
products.details: Two-button jacket with notch lapels, double vents and three interior pockets. Flat-front trousers with a side adjuster and an unfinished hem, taken up to your length in the shop.

products.title: Broadway navy suit
products.details: Slim two-piece in a navy twill. Narrow lapel, slanted pockets, tapered trouser. Works for an interview, a wedding or prom night.

products.title: Garratt grey suit

slot.line: The grey suit on a stand, front view, on sage.

products.details: Classic regular-fit suit with a fuller chest and straight leg. Comfortable through a long day.

products.title: Tooting grey three piece

slot.line: Jacket open over the waistcoat, close crop at the chest.

products.details: Jacket, waistcoat and trousers in a mid-grey flannel. Wear all three for a wedding and the two piece for work.

products.title: White formal shirt
products.details: Semi-cutaway collar with a double cuff option, in a cotton poplin. Collars 14½ to 18, sleeves 33 to 36.

products.title: Sage knitted tie

slot.line: The tie laid flat beside a folded white shirt.

products.details: Square-end knitted tie, 6cm. A soft colour for weddings and summer occasions.

products.title: Spare trousers, Mitcham charcoal

slot.line: The trousers folded over a hanger, hem unfinished.

products.details: A second pair in the Mitcham cloth doubles the life of the suit.

products.title: Balham black trouser suit
products.details: Single-button blazer with a soft shoulder and a straight-leg trouser with a little stretch. Jacket and trousers each sized 6 to 20.

products.title: Midnight satin prom dress

slot.line: Full length from behind, the train on the floor.

products.details: Floor-length satin dress with a fitted bodice, low back and a soft train. Hemmed to your height in the shop.

products.title: Ivory bridal gown

slot.line: The gown on a stand, lace bodice in close crop.

products.details: Lace bodice over a full tulle skirt with a chapel train. Fitted and hemmed for you in the shop before the day.

products.title: Sage midi occasion dress

slot.line: Midi length, shoulders down, against warm white.

products.details: Midi dress in a fluid crepe with a wrap front and short sleeves. For weddings, christenings and Eid.

products.title: Navy occasion jumpsuit

slot.line: Full length from the side, wide leg in movement.

products.details: Wide-leg jumpsuit with a tie waist. Formal without the dress.

products.title: Boys' navy suit
products.details: Two-piece navy suit for page boys, proms and communions. Pairs with the Broadway navy for father and son.

products.title: Boys' grey three piece

slot.line: Jacket, waistcoat and trousers laid flat together.

products.details: Jacket, waistcoat and trousers in mid grey, to match the Tooting three piece at a wedding.

products.title: Girls' ivory occasion dress

slot.line: The dress on a small hanger, tulle skirt spread.

products.details: Satin bodice and a layered tulle skirt for flower girls, communions and parties.

products.title: Boys' white shirt and bow tie

slot.line: Folded shirt with the bow tie resting on the collar.

products.details: Cotton shirt with a pre-tied bow tie on an adjustable band.

products.title: Made to measure
products.details: Your cloth and your cut, with two fittings in Tooting.
